technicalDocumentReport.summary: A simple, offline Python program that analyzes plain-text (.txt) documents. It calculates word count, character count (with and without spaces), non-empty paragraphs, section headings, and the top 10 frequent technical words while ignoring common English stop words.

files.file: Tkinter desktop application with document preview, calculated metric cards, and report export.
Terminal version for running the analysis without opening a graphical window.
Core functions for reading files safely, cleaning punctuation, counting metrics, and finding frequent words.
Python unittest suite with 7 test cases validating normal files, empty files, and error handling.

processFlow.step: User enters or selects a .txt file. Program verifies existence and reads UTF-8 content.
Converts text to lowercase and strips punctuation so words separate cleanly.
Calculates total words, characters, non-empty paragraphs, and headings.
Ignores common English stop words and counts remaining words in a Python dictionary.
Displays results on screen and offers to save a clean .txt report file.

limitations.limitation: Plain-text (.txt) files only. Binary formats like Word (.docx) or PDF are not supported.
Numbered procedural list items (like '1. Do this') are formatted like numbered headings and will be counted.
Stop words are based on standard English.
Plurals and singulars (like 'sensor' and 'sensors') are counted as separate words.
